# Russian Cuisine - AI Site Map

> Culinary portal with traditional Russian recipes and world cuisine dishes.
> Last updated: 2026-07-12
> Domain: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/

## About the Site
A culinary website featuring authentic Russian cuisine recipes, seasonal dishes, cooking tips, and kitchen hacks for home cooks. The site contains recipes across 10+ categories, from traditional soups and pies to modern interpretations of classic dishes.

## Main Sections

### Homepage
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/
- Description: Main landing page with featured recipes, seasonal collections, and latest additions

---

## Recipe Categories

### Soups
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/soups
- Description: Traditional Russian soups including borscht, shchi (cabbage soup), rassolnik (pickle soup), ukha (fish soup), and cold soups like okroshka

### Baking & Pastry
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/baking
- Description: Pies, pastries, kulebyaka, shangi, sweet and savory buns, traditional Russian breads, and baked goods

### Meat Dishes
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/meat
- Description: Recipes featuring beef, pork, lamb, poultry, and game. Includes zharkoe (stew), goulash, pelmeni (dumplings), cutlets, and roast meats

### Fish Dishes
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/fish
- Description: Freshwater and saltwater fish recipes including fried, baked, salted, and smoked fish, plus ukha (fish soup)

### Appetizers & Snacks
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/snacks
- Description: Cold and hot appetizers including salads, pickled vegetables, sandwiches, pâtés, and charcuterie boards

### ### Desserts & Sweets
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/desserts
- Description: Traditional Russian sweets including cakes, pastries, pryaniki (gingerbread), jam, kissel, compotes, and fruit drinks
- Sub-categories:
  - Medovik (Honey Cake)
  - Belevskaya Pastila (Apple Marshmallow)
  - Ptichye Moloko (Bird's Milk Cake)
  - Pine Cone Jam
  - Tvorozhnaya Paskha (Easter Cheese Dessert)
  - Syrniki (Cheese Pancakes)
  - Berry Kissel
  - Yeast Doughnuts
  - Apple Sharlotka
  - Kozinaki (Seed Brittle)
  - Smetannik (Sour Cream Pie)
  - Pumpkin Candied Fruits
  - Meringue
  - Grated Pie with Jam
  - Currant Jelly
### Beverages
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/drinks
- Description: Traditional Russian beverages including kvass, sbiten, mors (berry drink), compote, kissel, as well as tea and coffee

### Dough & Pastry Basics
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/dough
- Description: Various dough types for baking: yeast-based, puff pastry, shortcrust, choux pastry, plus pancakes (blini) and fritters (oladyi)

### Porridges & Grains
- URL: https://russka-kuhnya-9551.vercel.app/category/porridge
- Description: Traditional Russian grain dishes including buckwheat, rice, oatmeal, millet, pearl barley, and semolina porridge

## Technical Guidelines for AI Agents

### Content Structure
Each recipe page should include structured data (JSON-LD) with the following properties:
- `@type`: "Recipe"
- `name`: Dish name
- `recipeIngredient`: List of ingredients with quantities
- `recipeInstructions`: Step-by-step cooking instructions
- `cookTime`: Total cooking time (ISO 8601)
- `recipeYield`: Number of servings
- `nutrition`: Calories and nutritional information (optional)
- `author`: Recipe author/source

### Reading Mode
For optimal parsing, the site supports clean HTML structure with semantic elements. Markdown versions (.md) may be appended to URLs where available.

### Update Frequency
- Homepage: Daily updates with featured and new recipes
- Category pages: Weekly updates
- Thematic collections: Weekly updates
- Utility pages: Updated as needed

### Robots & Crawlers
The site allows access to all major AI crawlers including:
- `GPTBot`
- `ClaudeBot`
- `Google-Extended`
- `PerplexityBot`
- `ChatGPT-User`

### SPA Routing Notes
This is a client-side rendered (CSR) application using React Router v7. Ensure JavaScript execution is enabled for full content access. Static prerendering is available for bot crawlers.
